ideas.title: FBI Director's Lawsuit Against The Atlantic
ideas.description: Investigate the implications of Kash Patel's $250 million defamation lawsuit against The Atlantic and its potential impact on his role as FBI Director.
ideas.angle: The intersection of politics and journalism
questions: What are the potential consequences for Patel's career?
How will this lawsuit affect the FBI?
ideas.insight: This story could explore the blurred lines between personal and professional conduct for high-ranking officials.

ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Funding
ideas.description: Explore the potential impact of the $3.1B Medicaid hit on Minnesota's healthcare system, particularly for vulnerable populations.
questions: How will this funding shortfall affect patient care?
What are the potential long-term consequences for Minnesota's healthcare system?
ideas.insight: This story could delve into the data behind the funding shortfall and its implications for healthcare policy.
